question: Estimate the consumption of mangoes during peak summer (May-June) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total fresh mango consumption during peak season? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian annual mango production: ~21-22 MT (world's largest producer; ~50% of global).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Per-capita peak season: 14 MT / 1.45B = ~10 kg/person over 2 months.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
